svg.title: Database snapshot and restore
svg.desc: The owner checkpoints the write-ahead log, compresses the database, verifies the copy, records its checksum in the README and puts it in the team's shared folder. A teammate downloads it, checks the checksum and decompresses it to data/plp.db; the embeddings cache is rebuilt locally.
